supersededProtocol.supersessionReason: Independent source review discovered that V6 had 4 decisive defects: (1) createOfficialModelAdapter stubs rather than real Docker adapters; (2) unsigned JSON authorization gate without signature validation; (3) uninvoked physical audio byte verifier; (4) mutable trust root with silent fallback.
